title: Imports
purpose: Find specimen CSV uploads, review their validation results, export the register or open an import to commit it.
summary: The CSV files uploaded to register many specimens at once. Open one to review or commit it.

tasks.title: Register many specimens
steps: Select [[Upload CSV]] and validate your file.
Open the import, check it has no errors and commit it.

tasks.title: Export the register
steps: Filter the list, then select [[Export CSV]].

tasks.title: Find an earlier import
steps: Type part of the file name in [[Search]].

good_to_know: Uploading only checks a file. Nothing is registered until a valid file is committed, and then all rows or none.
An import expires 24 hours after validation. Upload the file again.
Every validation is listed, including repeats of the same file.

sections.title: Who can use it
paragraphs: Administrators, managers and technicians can open and export this register. Uploading a file validates it. Technicians can commit their own valid imports. Managers and administrators can also commit files validated by other staff. A commit registers all rows together.

sections.title: Search, sorting and paging
paragraphs: Search matches part of the file name. Click Import, Rows or Validated to sort (default newest validated first); choose 25, 50 or 100 rows per page. Every validation is listed, including repeats of the same file.

items.label: Import
items.description: File name, or the validation time when the browser sent none. Opens the import. Always shown.

items.label: State
items.description: Has errors (nothing can be registered), Ready to commit, Expired (validated more than 24 hours ago) or Committed.

items.label: Rows
items.description: How many specimen rows the file had.

sections.title: Actions and empty state
paragraphs: Upload CSV opens the upload form. With no imports the page says “No imports yet” and explains the steps; with a search that matches nothing it says so and offers to clear it.

sections.title: Export CSV
paragraphs: Select Export CSV to download the six register columns for every import matching your applied search, in the selected sort order. An empty selection downloads the headings. If more than 10,000 imports match, narrow the file-name search and select Apply. Correct any filter errors before downloading.

Each row gives the state at download time and the validation time in UTC. Open the individual import for specimen rows and validation messages. The download history records who exported the register, the applied search and sort, and the number of rows.
